summary: An adult reticulated giraffe (4.6 m to the ossicones, 2.9 m at the withers) on the engine's quadruped_20 rig… options coat, patches_colour, pattern; sockets head_top, back, collar.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.giraffe or place "prefab": "giraffe" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
